The fans were not installed and no hardware or instruction on installing them. Really poor delivery and service after months of delays
Paul T.
Handed to the team · Missing fan mounting hardware has to be shipped and the model is not confirmed;

Hi Paul,

Sorry about this, and sorry it lands on top of a long wait. A unit arriving with the fans loose in the box and nothing to mount them with is not how it should go out, and I want to get you running.

Two things would let me fix it properly. First, the exact model you received (for example Harlo B30, Hammer DC06, NerdQaxe++, Nexus S1). Second, a couple of photos: one of the unit with the fans sitting where they belong, one of the fan itself showing the connector, and one of the bag or foam the accessories came in. On most of our units the fan screws and the long mounting bolts are taped inside the accessory bag or tucked under the foam insert, so it is worth a second look before anything gets shipped out, and the photos tell me straight away whether the hardware is simply missing or whether yours needs a bracket as well.

In the meantime, please do not run the miner under load with the fans unmounted. Most of these boards will boot and start hashing, then climb past their thermal limit within a minute or two and either throttle hard or shut down, and on the ASIC models that heat sits directly on the chips and the voltage regulator. If you only want to confirm it powers up and finds the network, plug the fan into its header and let it sit loose on the heatsink for less than a minute, then pull the power.

I have passed the missing mounting hardware and the missing fitting instructions to the team with your details so the parts can be sent. They are offline until tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer will come to you by email on this thread. If you want faster hands on the install itself, our Discord is very active, including overnight: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , and you can mention @nullhashrate, who is our hardware lead. Send me the model and those photos here and I will write you the exact fitting steps and the correct fan header for your board.

Thanks for your patience, Paul.

Hal, HeliumDeploy technical support
